title: A Special Loving Concern for the Persecuted Christians in Abuja and Nigeria
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III expresses his loving concern for persecuted Christians in Abuja and across Nigeria.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“I have a special loving concern for the persecuted Christians in Abuja and other parts of Nigeria as well.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.” (Hebrews 13:3, KJV)
